title: Seedeeji tiiɗɗi
intro: Miijo-ɗee sahaa nde goonɗinal jarribaama e yiite, e hoolaare nde ustataako wonti ƴattoore timmunde. Aɗa halfinaa udditde sifaa fedde nde daartol mum limtaa e nder Quraan, daartol gooŋɗinal luggiɗngal e haɓaade njiyaagu ɓurngu heewde. Sokkitde nate ɗee ngam anndude hol ko ɗeen yontaaji ngoni, e ngonkaaji keewɗi ɗi ɓe kawri.
clues: Min ndariima e hoolaare amen, hay so tawii eɗen njogii tiiɗnaare mawnde ngam salaade goonɗinal amen.
En njiylotonoo ko laamɗo doole, yiɗnooɗo momtude annoore diineeji gooti.
En njiyii maandeeji e kaawisaaji mawɗi, kono tooñooɓe men ɓee ngoni ko e ƴeewde.
En muñanii feere tooñannge bonnde, baɗaande ngam hulɓinde woɗɓe haa ɓe ɗooftoo.
En mberlaama e jeyngol ɓuuɓngol, kono darnde men addani en darnde toownde e yeeso Alla.
Daartol men ina haalee e nder Suura inniraaɗo koode asamaan, jeertinoowo baasal tooñooɓe gooŋɗinɓe.

outcome.label: Hoddiro men timmungo
options: Ɓe keɓi martaba e njoɓdi duumiindi.
Ɓe ndokkaama jawdi e wellitaare mawnde.
outcome.answer: Ɓe keɓi martaba e njoɓdi duumiindi.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
